_eligibility_text:
> **A) Rural Area:** 1. The beneficiary shall belong to the identified Below Poverty Line (BPL) category household. 2. The beneficiary shall not have their own House/House Site anywhere in the State of Andhra Pradesh. 3. The Beneficiary shall not have been covered in any previous Housing Scheme of the State/Central Government. 4. The Beneficiary shall not have more than 2.5 acres of Wet Land or 5.00 acres of Dry Land.
> **B) Urban Area:** 1. The beneficiary shall not have an Own House/House Site anywhere in the State of Andhra Pradesh. 2. The beneficiary shall not have been covered in any previous Housing Scheme of the State/Central Government. 3. The beneficiary shall not have more than 2.5 acres of Wet Land or 5.00 acres of Dry Land. 4. The Annual Income (from all the sources) of the Household should not exceed Rs.3,00,000/- (Rupees three lakhs only).
